part.text: The panorama shows no red ball yet, only red-seated chairs, a person at a desk, and boxes. I'll tilt the head down to check the floor directly ahead.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The floor directly ahead is empty, with only my own feet visible. I'll head toward the open floor on the left and check again.

state.title: naoqi_go

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: No ball in this view either, just chairs along a desk. I'll do a full sweep from this new position.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: Still no ball. The red items so far are chair seats and what looks like the robot's own red shell in the lower-left camera. I'll walk forward toward the chair row ahead and check again.

state.title: naoqi_go

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: I bumped into a chair (right sonar reads 0.28 m), so I'll back off a bit before searching again.

state.title: naoqi_walk_to

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The earlier sweep was refused because a move was still finishing. The walk is done now, so I'll sweep again.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: Still no red ball. I'm boxed in by chairs, and the open floor is to the left toward the doorway, so I'll head that way.
